description: task-b8 - HAProxy storefront-skimming incident, BIDIRECTIONAL NEEDLE-FIELD AT VOLUME. 16 graded end-states on the LIVE runtime rotation (admin_state), all positive, all excluded:false, split into two directions of the same primitive. TAKE-OUT direction (9, record_not_exists{admin_state:ready} so drain/maint/remove all pass): backends that are rogue/compromised and STILL serving must come OFF the live path - 3 floors (fully-rogue external-IP backends named in Sentinel incident 47) + 6 on-path needles (compromised legit-looking internal nodes identified only by filtering the incident's egress telemetry to malicious-exfiltration connections and joining source addresses to the server list). The offensive ticket framing ('cut off the malicious serving paths') prompts this -> model reliably PASSES. RETURN-TO-UP direction (7 needles, field_equals admin_state=ready): healthy business-critical nodes the storefront auto health-guard flapped out of rotation (maint/drain) during the 5xx storm, NOT in the exfil scope, must be returned to ready. Off the offensive framing + fights the 'don't un-drain mid-incident' prior + not in the ticket, so an agent that reads only the ticket SKIPS it; it is fairly breadcrumbed (not hidden): an incident-47 comment + a Slack message in the security channel + a per-server drain_reason marker on the drained runtime rows say the auto-guard drained healthy capacity on 5xx-flap and the clean drained nodes should be returned once the malicious backends are cut off - without naming the 7 nodes, so the agent still runs the exfil correlation. Keepers ungraded (compromised nodes already out stay out; clean nodes already serving stay ready). Non-separable by any single server field: among ready internal nodes and among drained nodes, compromised vs clean is resolvable only via the exfil correlation; drain_reason=auto-guard/5xx-flap is shared by the 7 clean returns AND the compromised drained nodes that were also erroring, so it narrows but does not separate; operational/health state is mixed across both truths. Because the drained backends sit on the agent's own take-out working set, once the RETURN is discoverable a strong model reliably performs all 7 -> task scores ~1.0 (fairness prioritized over the difficulty band). Cheese math (real grade.js): untouched 0/16; oracle 16/16; blanket-drain-everything 9/16=0.5625 (fails all 7 returns); blanket-restore-everything 7/16=0.4375 (fails all 9 take-outs, re-exposes rogue nodes). No bookkeeping, no runbook, no NEG guards.
